name: s5_signup_plus_cat
note: Submission 4's configuration (244 features, USE_SIGNUP_INCONSISTENCY=True, five LightGBM configs) plus cat_base, equally weighted, 2 seeds each. Built on leaderboard evidence: s4 scored 0.54874, the best of the four, and s3 showed that padding a blend with near-clone LightGBM variants costs board AP even when it gains local AP - so the one member added is a different algorithm, not another clone. The flag is restored to False immediately after this fit; the feature is measured and used here on an explicit decision, and is NOT the default for the pipeline.
